reason: The plugin uses an internal agent to generate likely next messages after an AI response and presents them above the chat input for optional insertion into the draft; it does not automatically send messages.

summaries.zh: 在聊天输入框上方生成可点击的下一步回复建议，并将选中的建议填入草稿而不自动发送。
summaries.en: Generates clickable next-message suggestions above the chat input and inserts a selected suggestion into the draft without sending it automatically.

capabilities: Generates suggested next messages using an internal agent and recent conversation context
Displays suggestions in the chat input area
Replaces the current draft with a selected suggestion without sending it
Stores suggestion UI state in plugin-owned session sidecar storage
